items.title: Optimum conditions to get best yield of ammonia

source_refs.note: Optimum conditions to get best yield of ammonia: a main subheading of 8.16.1 Synthesis of ammonia by Haber's process, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 184-184.

blocks.text: The most suitable conditions to get maximum yield of ammonia are:

items: Pieces of iron crystals present in a fused mixture of MgO, Al₂O₃ and SiO₂, as catalyst
